$ edit b/corpus_test.go  # ./b, which owns import and list, and uses export
$ FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test  # chain-twice-a

    what ran, in order:
        export ran

    --- PASS: TestCorpus/grid
        --- PASS: TestCorpus/grid/sheet
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/grid/sheet/export
PASS

$ edit testdata/grid/sheet.txtar  # export now rejects the grid, which says so
$ FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test  # chain-twice-a
    The root-package check for the module-root corpus runs in normal runs, so it runs after the update: go test ./...

$ FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./b  # chain-twice-b
    grid/sheet: import is blocked: the lift export failed on the case, and testdata/grid/sheet.txtar, out/export/error.txt, records its error.
    grid/sheet: A grid that export makes an export of, whose import makes a script of one quoted cell.
        list: Lists the files of the script's input view, with their bytes.
        out/list/files.txt is recorded, and the cell is blocked: the lift export, on list's path, failed on the case.
        If the cell should run, fix the lift or the case. If not, delete the section by hand; FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... leaves it in place.
    what ran, in order:
        export ran
--- FAIL: TestCorpus
    --- PASS: TestCorpus/export
    --- FAIL: TestCorpus/grid
        --- FAIL: TestCorpus/grid/sheet
            --- SKIP: TestCorpus/grid/sheet/import
            --- FAIL: TestCorpus/grid/sheet/list
    --- PASS: TestCorpus/script
FAIL
[exit 1]
$ edit testdata/grid/sheet.txtar  # export accepts the grid again, and its error is deleted by hand
$ go test ./b  # chain-twice-b
    grid/sheet: import is blocked: testdata/grid/sheet.txtar, out/export/outcome, records the lift export's outcome as "rejected".
    grid/sheet: A grid that export makes an export of, whose import makes a script of one quoted cell.
        list: Lists the files of the script's input view, with their bytes.
        out/list/files.txt is recorded, and the cell is blocked: the lift import, on list's path, has the committed outcome "blocked export", in out/import/outcome.
        Only the package that owns export runs it in a normal run, so this one can't tell whether an update runs list. Run FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./..., which reruns export, and delete nothing by hand before it has.
--- FAIL: TestCorpus
    --- PASS: TestCorpus/export
    --- FAIL: TestCorpus/grid
        --- FAIL: TestCorpus/grid/sheet
            --- SKIP: TestCorpus/grid/sheet/import
            --- FAIL: TestCorpus/grid/sheet/list
    --- PASS: TestCorpus/script
FAIL
[exit 1]
